context: Tatsuya visits the school festival in the city; he meets Asuka through Daichi's nephew's class.
purpose: small civic adult interaction — country uncle visiting city school

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: はじめまして、達也です。だいちの兄貴です。
lines.en: Nice to meet you, I'm Tatsuya. Daichi's brother (loosely).
lines.style: Country gruff warm formal-rural introducing-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: まあ、達也さん。だいちさんから、よくお話聞いてます。
lines.en: Oh, Tatsuya-san. I often hear about you from Daichi.
lines.style: Teacher warm gentle bright sincere-recognizing-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 田舎から、子供の文化祭、見に来ました。
lines.en: I came from the country, to see the school festival.
lines.style: Country gruff warm sincere proud-civic-warm sharing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: わざわざ、嬉しいです。お子さんも、喜びますね。
lines.en: Going out of your way — happy news. The kids will be happy too.
lines.style: Teacher warm gentle sincere appreciative-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: こういう学校の雰囲気、田舎にはないんで。
lines.en: School atmosphere like this — doesn't exist in the country.
lines.style: Country gruff warm gentle observational-civic-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 田舎も、私、好きですよ。空気が違うって、聞きました。
lines.en: I love the country too. Heard the air is different.
lines.style: Teacher warm gentle sincere bridging-warm appreciating, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: いつでも、田舎、遊びに来てください。
lines.style: Country gruff warm sincere generous-extending-warm closing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ぜひ。今日、文化祭、楽しんでくださいね。
lines.style: Teacher warm gentle warm sincere-extending-warm closing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.
